identity.title: The Core Mass Function in the Massive Protocluster G286.21+0.17 Revealed by ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We study the core mass function (CMF) of the massive protocluster G286.21+0.17 with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array via 1.3 mm continuum emission at a resolution of 1.0$''$ (2500 au).

evidence.quote: G286.21+0.17 (hereafter G286) is a massive protocluster associated with the $\eta$ Car giant molecular cloud at a distance of $2.5\pm0.3\:$kpc

claims.hypothesis: Is the high-mass CMF slope in G286 consistent with the Salpeter IMF?
claims.experiment: Dendrogram core identification, completeness correction, power law fit
claims.finding: Dendrogram CMF is consistent with the Salpeter IMF slope; clumpfind CMF is shallower

evidence.quote: slightly shallower than, but still consistent with, the index of the Salpeter stellar initial mass function of 1.35.

claims.hypothesis: Does the CMF show a peak or break near 1 Msun?
claims.experiment: Raw and completeness-corrected CMFs with varied algorithms
claims.result: Raw CMFs peak near 1 Msun but corrected CMFs are consistent with a single power law to ~0.5 Msun

evidence.quote: completeness-corrected CMFs are consistent with a single power law extending down to $\sim 0.5\:M_\odot$
